description: This file contains unit tests for helper functions in the 'doctor-config-analysis' module, focusing on formatting config paths, resolving nested config targets, and stripping unknown configuration keys.

methods.name: formatConfigPath
methods.description: Formats an array of configuration path segments into a dot-notated string, with array indices in brackets or default '<root>' for empty path.

methods.name: resolveConfigPathTarget
methods.description: Resolves a nested configuration target within an object based on a provided path array, returning the target object or null if not found.

methods.name: stripUnknownConfigKeys
methods.description: Removes unknown keys from a configuration object, returning a result with the cleaned config and a list of removed keys.
